claude_proposed_widenings.name: container_interaction
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current passive container shape records capacity and air supply but cannot express that retrieving an item from the container consumes a specific action quota.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Retrieving an item from the bag requires a Utilize action.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.overloaded_or_damaged
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Magic-item destruction is currently modeled only for charge exhaustion or a none case. Bag of Holding needs destruction triggered by overload or physical damage instead.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it is destroyed...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: PassiveOperation.trigger.extradimensional_collision
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a deterministic triggered clause caused by being placed inside another extradimensional space, but non-spell passive operations only support elapsed-time cadence today.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Placing a Bag of Holding inside an extradimensional space created by a Handy Haversack, Portable Hole, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: PassiveContainerState.inside_out_until_put_right
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The bag can enter a reversible unusable state after being turned inside out, which is a passive item/container state transition not representable in the current surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If the bag is turned inside out, its contents spill forth unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again.
